_README: Paste EXACT Notion property names, character-for-character. The sync layer reads ONLY this file for property mapping — nothing is guessed. Empty string = not yet provided; sync for that field is skipped (and surfaced as a config gap on the health page) until filled. Keys on the left are stable internal names used by the dashboard; values on the right are your literal Notion property titles.

stage._note: Set property to the exact Notion field name. Correct the option labels on the right to match Notion's exact option text if they differ.

stage_transition_timestamps._note: Exact Notion date-property name that stores WHEN the vehicle entered each stage. These are separate fields per your requirement so duration analytics don't parse edit history.

status_options._note: Exact Notion option labels for the IRQ status field.
